bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and analyzing structural inequities in multilingual language models, specifically focusing on performance disparities, capacity dilution (the curse of multilinguality), and tokenization fragmentation between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Reviewing existing literature that identifies and mitigates social biases through techniques like reducing token sensitivity during text generation, natural sentence prompting, and embedding lookup probing.
